mapper.select: SELECT o.student_id AS studentId, i.textbook_id AS textbookId, t.isbn AS isbn, t.title AS title, o.submit_snapshot AS submitSnapshot, i.quantity AS quantity FROM student_order_item i JOIN student_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'submitted' JOIN textbook t ON t.id = i.textbook_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId} ORDER BY i.textbook_id
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_order_item i JOIN student_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'submitted' WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND o.semester_id = #{semesterId}
